notes.title: September 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Hey lovely,

In this update we fixed a couple of issues:
1. Multiplayer avatar issues
2. Multiplayer start new game issues

More updates will follow up, thank you!

notes.title: NEW MEGA UPDATE: Improved Graphics!
notes.notes:
Hello dear bowling lovers,

We finally made a big game update and improve the graphics significally!

Try them out and kindly let us know what you think about them!

Thank you so much for your support,
Eduard

notes.title: NEW: PHYSICS UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713822/ddae5917c9546ee68128e727012e11573caf4c74.png[/img]Hello,

notes.title: NEW: MAJOR UPDATE!

notes.notes:

We started working on the multiplayer feature on our game.

notes.title: NEW CRAZY UPDATE YOU SHOULD TRY!
notes.notes:
Hello dear,

We made some changes:

- 3 New venues (Tabuk, Luxor and Oymyakon)
- Better ranking (daily, weekly, monthly and top 100 players)

Kindly let us know what you think about it.
